notes.title: Version 0.9.1
notes.notes:
Dear Island Master,

We are pleased to announce the release of Version 0.9.1 of Mushroom Island! Here are the update details:

(1) Fixed building interface bugs
(2) Optimized ranch functionality
(3) Adjusted game balance/values
(4) Added a new tutorial guide
(5) Increased the variety of crops
(6) Added more buildings
(7) Expanded the number of hireable workers

The game will continue to receive new content! If you have any suggestions, please email us at: casualfishgames@foxmail.com. We will reply within 48 hours!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3332040

notes.title: version 0.9.0
notes.notes:
Respected Lord of the Island,

Greetings! We are pleased to inform you that version 0.9.0 of "Mushroom Island" has been released! Below are the update details:

Fixed the resolution bug.

Added a new ranch feature.

Optimized in-game videos.

Improved the game screenshot function.

Balanced game数值 (numerical values).

We will continue to add new content to the game! If you have any suggestions or ideas, please feel free to email us at casualfishgames@foxmail.com. We will respond within 48 hours.

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy the new update!

Best regards,
The Mushroom Island Development Team
